text:
deploy-bot: START: multi-service rollout initiated by @alex -> env=prod, tag=release/v2.3.1. Services: runtime (commit abc1234), api (commit def5678), console (commit 7890abc). Canary=10% for api+runtime. Change window: 2026-03-27T03:00-04:00Z. Release notes: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/v2.3.1. Monitor on #incidents if anything spikes :eyes:

alex: acknowledged. I’ll watch canary logs and alerts.

deploy-bot: runtime: rollout finished -> runtime@abc1234 -> status: SUCCESS on pool-gpu-1 :white_check_mark:

jamie: nice one, runtime looks healthy from perf dash. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: api: canary deployed -> api@def5678 -> healthchecks failing (2/3 pods) - returning 502s. Rolling back canary paused.

lee: seeing 502s too, traces point to header mismatch on auth service. tagging for rollback.

jamie: can we pin console to the previous release until api is stable? console depends on new api feature.

product-ops: hold full rollout. If api is unstable we should not promote console. Please coordinate rollback or patch.

sre-oncall: pausing canary and collecting logs. @alex can you grab the auth error trace from the failing pod?

alex: grabbing logs now. snippet: `Error: invalid header: X-Client-Id missing` from api pod `api-5f7b8d`. Looks like runtime change altered header casing. Repro locally, pushing a quick patch branch `hotfix/api-fix-headers`.

lee: recommendation: rollback api canary to release/v2.3.0 and pin console. If patch is small we can re-run canary after merge.

deploy-bot: ACTION: starting rollback for api -> target tag `release/v2.3.0` (commit zyx9876). Command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=release/v2.3.0`

deploy-bot: api rollback in progress...

deploy-bot: api rollback complete -> api@zyx9876 -> status: SUCCESS :white_check_mark:

jamie: pinning console to `release/v2.3.0` and cancelling its rollout.

deploy-bot: console deployment paused/pinned as requested by jamie -> console remains at `release/v2.3.0`.

product-ops: changing change-window note: full rollout will wait until patch verified. Extended window approved from 03:00-05:00Z.

alex: pushed `hotfix/api-fix-headers` PR, small header normalization fix. CI green. Will request quick review from @lee and re-run canary when merged.

lee: reviewing now. If green I’ll approve and trigger canary redeploy at 03:15Z.

jamie: adding rollback record to release notes and tagging the rollback commit: `release-rollbacks/2.3.1-api-canary` -> https://git.internal/redwood/rollbacks/2.3.1

sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards set to +15min retention for this rollout. Alerts suppressed for noisy infra alerts while we stabilize.

deploy-bot: FINAL STATUS: runtime -> SUCCESS (abc1234). api -> ROLLED_BACK to release/v2.3.0 (zyx9876) SUCCESS. console -> PINNED to release/v2.3.0 (paused). Canary paused. Next steps: merge hotfix, re-run canary at 03:15Z, re-evaluate for full promotion.

alex: thanks all. Will update thread when canary re-run starts. :shipit:

jamie: noted and documented. Closing until next update. :white_check_mark:
